about_the_game:
**THIS GAME IS STILL IN ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT.**

Fast-Paced Roguelike Action

Engage in electrifying high-speed combat that combines dynamic attacks and over the top, slapstick violence. With each run, adapt and evolve your playstyle as you discover new part combinations and upgrades to dominate increasingly tougher foes.

Key Features

Unique Part-Swapping System: Customize Zippy with scavenged body parts, unlocking endless possibilities for strategy and playstyle.

Fast-Paced Combat: Dive into frantic, skill-based battles where every decision and every part counts.

Dynamic Progression: Each run offers new challenges, upgrades, and surprises ensuring no two fights are ever the same.

A World of Contrast: Delight in a whimsical world hiding a story of survival and unexpected strength.

name: Break-a-bot

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @2.30 GHz or higher / AMD Ryzen 3 @3.00 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 4GB VRAM or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 @2.60 GHz or higher / AMD Ryzen 5 @3.00 GH or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060 6GB VRAM or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Defend your spaceship in Break-a-Bot, a vibrant roguelike where you battle cyborg raiders and customize your playstyle by scavenging enemy parts. Swap body parts in fast-paced combat to adapt and survive. Protect your home and become the galaxy’s most fearsome little robot!
